headline: Marban Hollow Ignites Amid Heavy Nevish Fighting
war_summary: Since the midday edition the wire has shifted south and west, with Marban Hollow reporting five changes in the last two hours around Checkpoint Bua and Maiden's Veil to stand seven Colonial-held with one unheld, while casualty rates in the last hour jumped to 411 Colonial and 484 Warden. The Nevish Line remains the heaviest sustained sector with 47 changes on the day, four in two hours, now six Warden to two Colonial around Grief Mother, Princefal and The Scrying Belt with day losses near 6,285 Colonial and 6,585 Warden, last heard at 17:33. Palantine Berm has renewed after its lull with five changes in two hours and 36 on the day to stand seven Warden-held around Leiri Hermanni, and the Weathered Expanse counts three in two hours and 21 on the day at two Warden to seven Colonial around Shattered Advance and Crow's Nest, last heard at 18:16. Stlican Shelf shows three in two hours and 11 on the day with Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost active, while Kuura Strand and Callahan's Passage have gone quiet in the last two hours despite busy days of 21 and 29 changes.
